rationale: S-0055-02 proposes re-running the t0055 Mg-block sweep on the corrected EPSP_PASSIVE / IPSP_PASSIVE protocol so EPSP and IPSP traces become spike-free synaptic envelopes. The from-scratch family (t0052 - t0059) has been deprioritised; the corrected measurement protocol has already been applied to the deposited Bed A and Bed B substrates in t0065 and t0066, providing the cleaner cross-bed comparison the project actually needs. Re-validating the t0055 finding inside the from-scratch substrate adds limited value to the current critical path. Rejecting as stale.
